reference.pathophysiology: Hyperbaric spinals climb with position to T4 surgical levels with Bromage dense legs while epidural loss threads catheters with adrenaline test-doses; sympathectomy hypotension co-loads with phenylephrine, PDPH postures for blood-patch sealing, and ASRA clocks guard haematoma holds.
additionalDifferentials: Spinal versus epidural by onset density and catheters
Hypotension versus high block by fluids pressors and airways
PDPH versus pneumocephalus versus haematoma by posture air and clocks
